summary_en: ¥30.0B acquisition frame for 16.0M shares (16.3% of shares outstanding) over 12 months from 22 Jun 2026 to 21 Jun 2027 via open-market purchase. To support capital-efficiency improvement and early execution of long-term share cancellation target (∼38.4M shares accumulated since 2006–07).
title_en: Notice Regarding Setting of Share Acquisition Framework (¥30.0 Billion)
translation_en_brief:
GMO Internet Group announced on 19 June 2026 a new share buyback authorization of ¥30.0 billion (upper limit) to acquire up to 16.0 million shares (16.3% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) over a 12-month execution window from 22 June 2026 to 21 June 2027. Purchases will be made via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

The buyback supports the company's capital-allocation policy targeting a total shareholder-return ratio of 50%, with dividends set at ≥33% of parent net income and share buybacks targeting the remaining allocation. This new frame advances the company's long-standing goal to acquire and cancel approximately 38.4 million shares issued during the 2006–07 loan-credit business exit (to date: 20.78 million acquired at 54.2% progress, 10.45 million cancelled at 27.3% progress). Acquired shares are planned to be cancelled sequentially at a rate equivalent to 17% of parent net income (the spread between the 50% total-return target and the ≥33% dividend floor).
